{{Quote|We were not prepared for an attack.|Oniye Namanda discusses the attack in a later report|<ref name="P:TF1" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] [[Vaklin insurgents|insurgents]] attacked an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Command center (Vaklin)|command center]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]] as part of the [[Vaklin insurgency]]. The insurgents attacked the center in the hope of rescuing a [[Unidentified reptilian Jedi Knight|Jedi Knight]] who was imprisoned there. During the attack they instead encountered the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who killed the entire assault force. During the chaos the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to break free and attack Vader as well, but he to was killed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Cho'na Bene is too sssmart for you. Too smart to take the bait.|The Jedi Knight refuses to believe that his fellow Jedi will make a rescue attempt|<ref name="P:TF1" />}}
Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], an [[Vaklin insurgency|insurgency]] took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]] against the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Vaklin insurgents]] were lead by three members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and so the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] traveled to the planet to lead the Imperials in crushing the insurgency as part of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Vader [[Death/Legends|killed]] one [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Shrokaan)|Jedi Master]] and then captured a [[Unidentified reptilian Jedi Knight|Jedi Knight]], leaving only the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cho'na Bene]] at large. Bene continued to harass Vader's forces after the Knight's capture, and twelve days after the capture [[Ambush in the Howling Ruins|ambushed]] Vader whilst he was on patrol. Shortly after the ambush, Vader returned to the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Vaklin Zenith]], where an Imperial [[Command center (Vaklin)|command center]] was located. At the command center he discussed the Insurgency with several [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]], before visiting the Jedi Knight, who was imprisoned in the center. Vader hoped that Bene would be drawn out of hiding to attempt to rescue the Jedi, but sucesfully interrogated the captive as to the Jedi Master's location in case he didn't work as bait.<ref name="P:TF1" />

==The attack==
{{Quote|The Force guides us. The Force frees us.|The Jedi uses the Force to free himself during the attack|<ref name="P:TF1" />}}
The attack began with an explosion caused by an explosive device planted inside a [[MSE-series]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], which the insurgents sent directly into the command center. This caused damage to three levels of the building and allowed three armed insurgents to enter near the holding cells, where they encountered Vader interrogating the Jedi. The insurgents attacked Vader, but using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he collapsed part of the passage they were fighting in and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the trio. The Sith lord's distraction allowed the Jedi prisoner to break his [[Stuncuffs/Legends|stun cuffs]] and also attack the Sith, but Vader cut him down with a single sweep of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. One room damaged by the attack was the conference room in which Vader had previously spoken with Imperial Officers, several of whom were still there when the room collapsed. Whilst Vader fought the insurgents elsewhere in the building, [[Oniye Namada]], a [[Major/Legends|Major]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], rallied the officers in the conference room and looked after one who had been wounded, with the help of two other officers from the meeting.<ref name="P:TF1" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|For a few hours, we felt giddy and satisfied with our response.|Namanda records the Imperial response to the failed attack|<ref name="P:TF1" />}}
After the attack the Imperial forces were initially pleased with their response, considering the attack a failure. The local population however saw the strike as a valiant effort and remembered the Jedi as a martyr and a hero. When the Imperials were forced to retreat to a [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] orbiting the Vaklin due to the damage to the center, the local celebrations got even worse. Angered by the populations response, Vader then ordered Namanda to begin a purge of anything Jedi-related from Vaklin, in an effort to make them forget the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and stop supporting the insurgency. The details of the attack were later recorded by Namanda in an ISB report titled [[I-1807-VAK]].<ref name="P:TF1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack first appeared in [[2012]] in [[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 1|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 1]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] in the [[Purge (comic book)|''Star Wars: Purge'']] series. The comic was written by [[Alexander Freed]] and penciled by [[Marco Castiello]] and [[Andrea Chella]].
